verdict.rationale: Paddle runs some configurable processes in the background. Payment Recovery retries failed payments automatically, and you can choose Tactical Retries and what happens to past-due subscriptions. Paddle also creates lifecycle transactions automatically, rotates API keys on a schedule via AWS Secrets Manager, and pushes webhooks that your own server can act on. However, the MCP server and agent skills are interactive, request-driven agent tools, not autonomous background automations. missing for 10: a user-defined workflow or automation builder, scheduled or triggered agent runs inside Paddle, autonomous agent execution without a human prompting, independent corroboration.
